text:
rachel: deploy-bot reports canary instability in us-central after an automated values bump. ~30% 502s on canary. change: db.max_conn=6000 from values-sync.

deploy-bot: [ALERT] canary-unhealthy us-central - 7/24 pods failing healthcheck (502) - change-id values-sync-2024-07-28 - rc: rc-2024-07-28-42

tom: only us-central canary affected, staging/prod look fine. metrics show connection queue length and upstream timeouts right when the canary spikes.

nina: Values-sync bumped both a values overlay and chart minor (v4.0.1 -> v4.1.0). We should avoid a full chart rollback immediately. Proposal: a) apply per-namespace canary override to revert db.max_conn -> 120, b) hold promotion, c) request exemption for values-sync for this chart family, d) pin the chart for any promotion until a follow-up validated patch lands.

rachel: Agreed. Tom, can you apply the override and restart the canary? Keep the change scoped to the canary namespace.

tom: running:

kubectl -n us-central create configmap mysvc-canary-values --from-literal=db.max_conn=120 -o yaml --dry-run=client | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl -n us-central rollout restart deployment/mysvc-canary

ops-bot: creating ticket INF-5001, placing promotion hold for rc-2024-07-28-42, noting pin request for chart v4.0.1.

deploy-bot: action -> applied canary override; pinned candidate chart v4.1.0 -> v4.0.1 for promotion gating; hold set; ticket INF-5001.

rachel: I'll update release-notes: "Temporary revert: db.max_conn reverted to 120 in us-central canary. Promotion held pending 30m stable health. Values-sync exemption requested. If instability persists, we'll roll back the RC and run a short post-incident review."

nina: If canary recovers in 20m we unhold and keep chart pin until a validated fix is merged. If not, escalate to full RC rollback and notify infra on-call.

tom: override applied, restart triggered. Monitoring logs and 502 counts; will report back in 15m. :hourglass:
